selected_candidate.reason: Most complete independent candidate: immutable expected snapshots, full pinned upstream fixture set, and process-only oracle refresh boundary. It failed compilation only in oracle chunk accounting and failed the format gate because cargo fmt traversed byte-frozen vendored source.

rejected_candidates.reason: Both runs timed out and did not create the required single candidate commit.
Compilation failed because snapshot Color lacked Hash; checked-in corpus had no independent Ghostty expected snapshots, violating the differential contract.
Candidate disclosed copying another candidate worktree, violating independent implementation; it also shared the oracle compile failure.

required_changes: Fix mr-crabs-oracle chunk accounting with explicit usize types and checked arithmetic; no casts that can truncate.
Make cargo fmt --all -- --check validate owned Rust code without rewriting or traversing the byte-frozen vendored Alacritty source. Preserve every vendored source byte and its provenance hashes.
Resolve every cargo check, test, and clippy error without suppressing warnings or weakening assertions.
Ensure the checked-in ANSI/DEC corpus contains immutable normalized expected snapshots and the runner compares every whole/split/random chunk execution against them.
Ensure every short case runs every possible byte split and long cases run deterministic seeded randomized chunking.
Ensure Cell remains exactly 8 bytes and has a focused assertion.
Ensure mr-crabs-app cargo tree contains no ghostty, zig, libghostty-vt, wgpu, or sugarloaf dependency.
Do not change the S1 contract, pins, selected architecture, or any source outside rust/. Do not launch GUI applications.
acceptance: cargo tree -p mr-crabs-app contains no forbidden dependency
execution: Grok implements only this synthesis in the integration worktree, skips validation, commits once, and reports the commit SHA. The lead runs every acceptance command.
